findings.expected: Represent every visible nested part and preserve its parent_part_id.
findings.observed: All 115 part records have null parent_part_id_or_null. The 21 unresolved records use bare label i as a sibling, while source pages show roman labels nested under alphabetic parts; further child labels are absent.
findings.impact: Part boundaries, MS links, displayed marks, and context dependencies cannot be trusted at child-item level.
findings.retest: Re-index nested children with exact QP locators and parent IDs; then A4 verifies against the paired originals.

findings.topic: Displayed marks and marking conditions are not recorded
findings.expected: Copy only marks visibly associated with a QP question/part and identify MS conditions without inferring allocations.
findings.observed: 48/48 question records and 115/115 part records have null displayed-mark fields. 94/94 marking records have null mark_or_condition_or_null.

evidence.observation: Visible bracketed marks accompany the nested parts.
MS has distinct subpart criteria beneath the parent label.

findings.impact: Displayed marks, totals, and allocation boundaries cannot be reviewed from the corpus records.
findings.retest: Populate only explicitly visible values at the correct hierarchy level; retain null where association is ambiguous.

findings.topic: Parent-context MS locators are presented as part links
findings.expected: Distinguish a parent/page context locator from an exact leaf marking-item locator.
findings.observed: All 94 locators point to a matching MS source and a page containing the parent label or descendants; 43 cited parent labels expand into multiple roman-numbered MS entries. Example: one Q1(a) link points to 9618_s21_ms_11 page 3, where separate Q1(a)(i) and Q1(a)(ii) entries appear.
findings.impact: A downstream reader could incorrectly treat a page-level parent link as an exact marking-row match.
findings.retest: Use explicit parent-context link type or create child links at the visible MS labels; do not infer marks.

findings.topic: Visual and table dependencies are not related to indexed items
findings.expected: Connect relevant visual regions, table rows, and answer conditions to the question/marking records they qualify.
findings.observed: All 51 visual regions have empty relates_to_ids. All 94 marking records have empty visual_dependency_refs and table_row_ref_or_null.
findings.impact: The corpus cannot identify which visual/table structures need to be consulted for an indexed answer.
findings.retest: Populate item relationships where supported by the page; otherwise keep unresolved and state why.

non_findings: All 12 source hashes and page counts independently matched the A2 manifest.
All 94 marking locators use the corresponding session/component MS source and a page where the referenced label or nested descendants occur.
No source-pair mismatch or impossible MS page locator was found.
